input.name: input_values
input.preprocessing: raw 16k mono PCM in [-1,1]; NO external normalization (preprocessor do_normalize=false; HuBERT uses internal group norm)

g2p.device_option_evidence: Option A (bundle OpenJTalk+dict via JNI). The reference chain (ja_pronunciation.py) needs MeCab morphological analysis plus the Open JTalk dictionary to read kanji; the same-source Open JTalk 1.11 frontend is what pyopenjtalk calls. Local evidence: open_jtalk_dic_utf_8-1.11 is 103.07 MB raw (sys.dic) / 21.67 MB gzip, Open JTalk+HTS Engine are BSD-family (see REPORT.md section 4.3). Option B (pure Kotlin port) was NOT delivered and cannot be accepted without a full dictionary+morphology re-implementation validated against the golden vectors; option C would make JA undeliverable.

quantization.int8: dynamic QInt8, per-channel, MatMul/Gemm only; CTC head (lm_head MatMul) excluded — see docs/QUANTIZATION_CALIBRATION.md
